audience: recruiters and staffing teams that manage candidates and jobs in the Traffit ATS

useCases.title: See the candidates that were added recently
useCases.text: List candidates with a filter on the creation date. Open one candidate to read the contact data and status.

useCases.title: Count the candidates in each stage of a job
useCases.text: Get the number of candidates per pipeline stage of one job. List the candidates in one stage.

useCases.title: Read the history of a candidate
useCases.text: Read the activities of a candidate: notes, stage moves and mails. List the jobs that the candidate takes part in.

useCases.title: Review client companies and their contacts
useCases.text: List client companies and the contact people. Read the CRM activities such as calls and meetings.

useCases.title: Record a note after a call
useCases.text: Add a text note to the activity history of a candidate, so the team sees what you discussed.
